controls.title: Layers
controls.basisHelp: How the cheapest option is defined. Default: uniform 8% financing and a fixed 2:1 renewables-to-electrolyser ratio. Risk-adjusted WACC: applies each country's cost of capital instead of a flat 8%. Best-achievable sizing: the lowest cost found by sweeping oversizing ratios and PV/wind mixes.

drawer.fallbackNote: This cell's wind uses the fallback model: a generic turbine curve with fixed shear, without the air-density and turbine-class corrections applied elsewhere. Outlined on the map so it is not read as directly comparable.
drawer.nonViableNote: Above {ceiling} USD/kg: this technology is not viable at this site, not merely expensive.
